policy.notes: Profiles are renderer arguments, not engine defaults. GPL/AGPL sources are reference-only. Historical Reference-A sweeps are supporting evidence and retain their original caveats.

analog_synth_p6_inspired.reason: Documented sync topology and several DSP choices are generic/incompatible with the Prophet-6 contract; useful only as architecture contrast.

reference_a_v09.description: Historical Reference-A v0.9 candidate including Phosphor-cross-checked Poly Mod spans

phosphor_pw_v019.description: Phosphor Prophet-6 PW prior only: distribute raw 0..255 over 4..96 percent duty instead of clamping after a nominal 0..100 percent mapping

reference_a_crosscheck.interpretation: Reference-A weakly prefers a larger inset in this historical two-case score, but v0.8 rejected endpoint/PW promotion because the effect was modest and phase/filter confounding remained.

reference_a_pw015_exploratory.description: Historical v0.8 PW-inset sweep minimum; retained for cross-checking only, not a promoted hardware law
reference_a_pw015_exploratory.caveat: v0.8 explicitly did not promote this result; unknown oscillator phase and filter/performance coupling were nuisance variables.

pulse_normalization_zero_exploratory.description: Historical Reference-A sweep endpoint that minimized the old aggregate pulse-normalization score
pulse_normalization_zero_exploratory.caveat: v0.8 explicitly retained normalization=1.0 because relaxing it improved one ratio by only about 0.8 dB and did not resolve the larger mismatch.

reference_a_v09_plus_phosphor_pw.description: Reference-A v0.9 candidate plus the independent Phosphor raw-to-PW prior

phosphor_poly_mod_v019.description: Explicit Phosphor Poly Mod span prior; equivalent to the span portion already carried by Reference-A v0.9

observations.reference_a_crosscheck: v0.8 broadband/staged mixer fits produced implausible compensating values and were rejected; no evidence to replace the linear default.
Brassed Off and Solid Bass requested contradictory sub compensation once phase was considered; v0.8 rejected a global sub-gain change.

observations.prior: raw 0..164 used directly as semitone-like cutoff-note coordinate
observations.prophecy_current: legacy family is one semitone/raw; Reference-A v0.7 deliberately diverges
observations.difference: Reference-A candidate differs and has stronger acoustic support
observations.reference_a_crosscheck: v0.7 weighted score improved from 19.3346 to 12.4566 (-35.6%) with base 88.97695 Hz and slope 0.37 semitone/raw.

observations.prophecy_current: linear raw/255 with optional calibration scale
linear raw 0..255 -> nominal 0..1 then oscillator clamp 0.04..0.96
observations.reference_a_crosscheck: Historical sweep ranked inset 0.04 at 10/13; best was 0.15, but v0.8 judged endpoint changes modest/confounded and promoted neither.

reference_a_crosscheck.interpretation: The old aggregate score weakly preferred removing the extra normalization, but v0.8 retained 1.0 because the gain effect was too small to explain the mismatch and phase/filter confounding dominated.

observations.prior: pitch 4 oct, shape 1.0, PW 0.5, filters 7 oct
observations.prophecy_current: same in Reference-A v0.9; legacy default is smaller for shape/PW/filter
observations.reference_a_crosscheck: Reference-A v0.9 could not isolate individual destinations cleanly; values remain named candidates rather than measurements.

observations.reason: Project is P6-inspired rather than a state-compatible emulator; contradiction lowers its calibration weight instead of creating a candidate.
